_meta.status: PROPOSED - k/cap adopted from calibration; band scale PENDING user decision

blend.k_rationale: calibrated gamma: overall +0.32 (t=+10), off +0.36, def +0.35; stable 2023-2025 (~0.36-0.37), weaker 2022 (0.18); threshold sensitivity 0.28-0.33; rounded DOWN for membership-lookahead caveat. Old default 0.5 was too aggressive.
blend.cap_rationale: tail linearity holds (|resid|>4: gamma 0.32, t=9.8) so the old +-5 cap was tighter than evidence requires; +-6 binds only ~p90 of |k*resid|. Pilot-tune.
blend.residual_vs: blended anchor (production); calibration measured vs SP+ alone - re-verify at pilot
blend.power_adjustment: NONE standalone. The 2021-2025 power/G5 anchor bias (power teams -3.8 pts vs G5 in realized misses, 4 of 5 years) is SUBSUMED by the grade residual (corr resid~power = -0.70; power coef dies to -0.4 t=-0.5 once resid included). Applying both would double-count.

mechanical_churn_adjustments.returning_production: NONE - priced by real preseason SP+ (t=+1.1 vs real misses)
mechanical_churn_adjustments.portal: NONE - both bluechip count and 247 class rankings priced (t~=0); portal features dropped from anchor adjustment entirely

variance.PENDING: user decision on in-season noise assumption: resid SD 7.67 -> epistemic 6.5/6.2/5.8 at noise 4.0/4.5/5.0. Brief sanity scale (avg +-3.5-4.5) is inconsistent with portal-era data.

multipliers.notes: returning-production and class multipliers FLAT vs real misses - dropped. Coach-change bump survives. Snapshot data-confidence bumps to be added at grading time per brief.

market_benchmark_2025.note: anchor ~= market quality; both miss the same teams; edge must come from signal orthogonal to both (the grades layer).

flagged_for_future.coach_subtypes: first-FBS-job-at-G5 (FCS->G5 proxy) +0.86 vs others -1.03 mean miss (t=+1.3, n=52); prior-FBS-HC-exp +0.94 vs -1.22 (t=+1.4, n=58). Suggestive, underpowered - revisit after 2026.
flagged_for_future.calibration_2022_weakness: gamma 0.18 in 2022 vs ~0.36 later - 2021 PFF season thinner/COVID-odd; watch if adding years.
